question: Win $20 on heads, lose $10 on tails. What do 100 tosses bring?
answer: Each toss is pure luck, either +$20 or −$10, but heads pays twice what tails costs, so each bet is worth +$5 on average. In 100 tosses heads comes up about 45 to 55 times, so every run lands near +$500. The chance of losing any money at all is about 1 in 2300.
move: One good bet is a gamble; a hundred of them is close to a sure win.
